comparison_method.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, retain word characters, collapse whitespace
comparison_method.holdout_components: each extraction candidate answer; each checking reference and claim separately
comparison_method.formal_benchmark_components: each query, gold answer, gold claim, evidence snippet, and provenance excerpt separately

result: no cross-set near duplicate at preregistered threshold
limitations: The check detects lexical near duplicates, not semantic paraphrases.
Checking cases deliberately reuse a reference for controlled Entailment/Neutral/Contradiction contrasts; this is within-holdout design and not cross-set contamination.
Independent gold review remains mandatory before any blind holdout inference.
